cases/collate.md#1.checks:
assert list(collate([1, 1, 5], [1, 2, 5])) == [1, 1, 1, 2, 5, 5]
assert list(collate([], [])) == []
assert list(collate(['-2', '12'], ['0', '15'], key=int)) == ['-2', '0', '12', '15']
assert list(collate([9, 3], [8, 1], reverse=True)) == [9, 8, 3, 1]

cases/grouper.md#1.checks:
assert list(grouper(iterable='ABCDEFG', n=3, fillvalue='x')) == [('A', 'B', 'C'), ('D', 'E', 'F'), ('G', 'x', 'x')]
assert list(grouper(iterable='ABCD', n=2, fillvalue='x')) == [('A', 'B'), ('C', 'D')]
assert list(grouper(iterable='', n=3, fillvalue='x')) == []
assert list(grouper(iterable='Z', n=2, fillvalue='!')) == [('Z', '!')]

cases/healthy_chunked.md#1.checks:
assert list(chunked(range(5), 2)) == [[0, 1], [2, 3], [4]]
assert list(chunked([], 3)) == []
assert list(chunked([1, 2, 3, 4], 2)) == [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
